title: Task-adapted S05 2D EM with a pilot-only causal Fourier snapshot

training.loss: BCE + normalized channel MSE + 0.25 PA residual, unweighted means
training.optimizer: Adam backbone 0.008, gamma 0.02, clip 2, cosine eta_min 0.0008
training.model: EMFloatFormer2D width 16, two heads, two blocks, 3-tap causal DFT pilot prior constant across time.
training.selection: Final update, all three prespecified seeds. No checkpoint selection.

test.primary: Per-slot channel NMSE, averaged before 10log10(nearest LS NMSE / model NMSE). Original >=4 dB requirement; report each replicate and each draw.
test.secondary: Uncoded payload hard bit errors; each full slot has 440*4 decisions.
test.controls: Unwrapped nearest LS, pilot LMMSE, identical static three-tap DFT prior, six-step joint soft MAP, and two-row-trained zero-shot EM.
test.interventions: Zero both directional cross-attention outputs (axial grid/pilot stream still active), or blank received payload grid (distribution-shift diagnostic). Frozen weights.
